- [FACT] The user is thinking of building a small cabin on a plot of land they inherited.

- [USER] The user is considering using a rainwater harvesting system in their cabin.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided benefits of a rainwater harvesting system, including water savings, lower water bills, increased water independence, reduced stormwater runoff, improved water quality, and increased property value.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant outlined costs associated with a rainwater harvesting system, ranging from $5,000 to $20,000, including components like roof catchment, gutters, storage tank, pumps, filtration, and installation labor.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned ongoing maintenance costs for the rainwater harvesting system, including annual inspections, filter replacements, and pump maintenance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided key considerations for rainwater harvesting, including roof size and material, storage tank size, system design and installation, water treatment, and local regulations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant offered tips for cost-effective rainwater harvesting, such as starting small, using existing infrastructure, choosing the right tank, DIY installation, and researching incentives and rebates.
